places\[someplace\].Properties.population.Value: cannot parse.*as integer: using 0
-- test.glx --
places:
  someplace:
    name: Someplace
    type: county
    properties:
      # population is an integer property.
      population: "string instead of integer"
-- want-catalog.yaml --
places:
  someplace:
    type:
      definition: County
      value: county
    properties:
      population:
        definition:
          label: Population
          value_type: integer
        values:
          # using 0
          - value: IntValue(0)
